notes:
I couldn't confirm any toddler drop-in playgroup running today (Tuesday, Nov 10) from an operator's own page. These three are real Ottawa EarlyON drop-ins, but I couldn't read a posted time for today on any of them. I left `when` out rather than guess.

- **City View Centre (Nepean/Richmond):** 
The playgroups are funded as an EarlyON Child and Family Centre and are for children 0-6.
 
Participation is drop-in and free of charge for residents.
 The page lists locations but no times.
- **Western Ottawa Community Resource Centre (2 MacNeil Court):** 
All in-person EarlyON programs are drop-ins and no registration is required.
 
They are geared towards children from birth to 6 years old.
 The only calendar I found is last spring's, so I didn't use it for times.
- **Global Child Care Services EarlyON Drop-Ins:** 
They run weekly at locations around Ottawa, with activities for infants, toddlers and preschoolers.
 
Attendance is free.
 The fall schedule table was cut off in what I could read, so I couldn't pull a time for today.

The Ottawa Public Library's booking page also shows 
a Family Storytime and Stay & Play listed for Tuesday Nov 10 at 10:30am
. The result didn't say which branch, so I didn't list it as a pick.
